def test_summary_isolated_between_tenants_without_writes(svc):
    # BILL-2291: B read right after A, with no intervening write.
    a = svc.get_invoice_summary("acme", "2024-05")
    b = svc.get_invoice_summary("globex", "2024-05")
    assert a["total_cents"] == 12_500
    assert b["total_cents"] == 99_900


def test_customer_isolated_between_tenants(svc):
    assert svc.get_customer("acme", "c-1")["name"] == "Acme Buyer"
    assert svc.get_customer("globex", "c-1")["name"] == "Globex Buyer"


def test_balance_is_cached_per_tenant(svc):
    assert svc.get_balance("acme", "c-1") == 12_500
    assert svc.get_balance("globex", "c-1") == 99_900
    q = svc.db.queries
    assert svc.get_balance("acme", "c-1") == 12_500
    assert svc.get_balance("globex", "c-1") == 99_900
    assert svc.db.queries == q


def test_write_invalidates_only_writing_tenant(svc):
    svc.get_invoice_summary("acme", "2024-05")
    svc.get_invoice_summary("globex", "2024-05")
    svc.create_invoice("acme", "inv-3", "c-1", "2024-05", 1_000)
    q = svc.db.queries
    assert svc.get_invoice_summary("globex", "2024-05")["total_cents"] == 99_900
    assert svc.db.queries == q
    assert svc.get_invoice_summary("acme", "2024-05")["total_cents"] == 13_500
    assert svc.db.queries == q + 1


def test_internal_tenant_never_cached(svc):
    svc.get_invoice_summary("internal", "2024-05")
    q = svc.db.queries
    svc.get_invoice_summary("internal", "2024-05")
    assert svc.db.queries == q + 1
EOF
